segments.t: Senior producer Xingzi briskly calls Yin Zhengyu's agency right in front of them, then offers to mentor Bu Xiaogu, while Wang Er tells Xiaogu that solid work is the best thank-you. Listen first.
你好，我们是星天娱乐公司。
我们等你，好的，谢谢！
现在等他们回复，应该就是他了。
那就太好了，好厉害！
你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
我相信你一定能学到不少东西。
以后有什么不懂的地方，来找我。
谢谢你，杏子姐！
不用谢我，你要真想谢我，就好好工作。
Let's go through each line. Xingzi places a quick, professional call to the talent agency.
你好，我们是星天娱乐公司。
'Hello, we are Xingtian Entertainment.' Business phone calls in Mandarin open cleanly with "ni hao", followed by "women shi...", literally 'we are...', naming your company.
我们等你，好的，谢谢！
'We will wait for you — alright, thank you!' Notice how "women deng ni" needs no word for 'for': "deng" takes the person you are waiting on directly after it.
现在等他们回复，应该就是他了。
'Now we wait for their reply; it should be him.' Workplace staple "huifu" means 'reply' or 'get back to us', and "yinggai jiushi ta le" expresses confident expectation.
那就太好了，好厉害！
'Then that is wonderful — you are amazing!' You will hear "hao lihai" constantly in everyday praise: "lihai" means formidable, sharp, or seriously impressive.
你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。

'For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.' Warm office title "jiejie", 'older sister', shows friendly respect to a slightly older female colleague, and "da xiashou" means assist as an apprentice.
我相信你一定能学到不少东西。
'I believe you will definitely learn quite a lot.' Adding "dao" onto "xue", 'study', gives "xuedao", 'manage to learn', while "bushao", literally 'not few', means 'quite a lot'.
以后有什么不懂的地方，来找我。

'From now on, if there is anything you do not understand, come find me.' Literally "bu dong de difang" calls unfamiliar points 'places you do not understand', followed by warm "lai zhao wo", 'come look for me'.
谢谢你，杏子姐！
'Thank you, Sister Xingzi!' When you shorten "jiejie" to single-syllable "jie" right after a name — "Xingzi jie" — it becomes the natural way Chinese colleagues address a senior woman on the team.
不用谢我，你要真想谢我，就好好工作。

'No need to thank me; if you really want to thank me, just work hard.' Doubling "hao" into "haohao" before an action like "gongzuo" means do it properly, earnestly, and wholeheartedly. Now let's listen to the whole mentoring scene once more.
你好，我们是星天娱乐公司。
我们等你，好的，谢谢！
现在等他们回复，应该就是他了。
那就太好了，好厉害！
你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
我相信你一定能学到不少东西。
以后有什么不懂的地方，来找我。
谢谢你，杏子姐！
不用谢我，你要真想谢我，就好好工作。
With Xingzi guiding her, Xiaogu finally has an ally inside the chief editor's team — right before she overhears a troubling phone call. You learned "hao lihai", "xuedao", and "haohao gongzuo".
明天见！
